rule: Chosen on weekly origins 2003–2011: the highest mean over 1, 4 and 13 weeks of the quadrant matrix's Brier skill against the weaker of staying put and the usual shares; within 0.002, the higher correlation of RS-Momentum with the next four weeks' relative return. Reported from 2012 for every centre, whatever it shows.
note: Weekly closes adjusted for dividends (Yahoo Finance); cash: FRED DGS3MO. Odds from walk-forward matrices fitted on all weeks since 2002 for today's forecast; labels from origins since 2012 (weekly, overlapping, block bootstrap). Price ranges replay every 13-week run of the four together; next week's closes hold the other three (and the bill) where they are.
